title: The classifier key gets a verified setup path: a ~/.ticfacrc home and a ticfac factory setup rung
description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from wne's close-out (findings 8e6b611b, adb8b0fb). x0k shipped the classifier key as $TICFAC_JEV_API_KEY locally and the TYPESAFE_API_KEY factory secret. Two gaps: (1) contracts/credential-ownership.json is closed (additionalProperties: false) and the Go constants must match it, so a factory_jev_api_key in ~/.ticfacrc needs a bundle change plus the matching constant, mirror and Worker secret; (2) every other factory credential is walked by 'ticfac factory setup' one verified rung at a time, while this one is set by hand and first noticed when a run degrades to a recorded no-answer. Add the home and a rung that verifies the key with one real, cheap classification before storing it.
acceptance_criteria: The classifier key can live in ~/.ticfacrc under a key the credential-ownership contract declares; ticfac factory setup has a rung that verifies it with a real classification before writing it; and the contract and Go constants agree
